A desktop Thoughtloom UI state-study screen, edge to edge with crisp readable text, no browser frame or device. Use a landscape canvas with six clearly separated specimen panels, each an alternative moment, never simultaneous banners on one form. The supplied runtime image contributes only Quiet Night palette, Source Sans 3 type, restrained surfaces, familiar controls and shared navigation character. No illustration, checkmark icon or decorative graph. Label the board “Create connection · Alternative states · Illustrative thoughts”.

Show six compact but fully legible application-region specimens with real labels and retained input context:

1. “Find another thought”: query memory; Search; “Remember the question”, You · Original capture; expanded words “I often remember the question before I remember the note.”; Choose this thought. A small “No results” alternative says “Try another query”; a search read error retains the query with Retry search, which is a read only.
2. “Rationale required”: Category Extends, From Remember the question / To Questions before conclusions; blank Why are these connected? field; error “Explain why these thoughts are connected.” No lost selections.
3. “Creating connection…”: readonly submitted relationship and explanation “Remembering the question gives me a practical way to follow a useful connection.”; disabled Create connection and Cancel; “Waiting for confirmation. This request has already been sent.”
4. Confirmed green worded “Connection created · Proposed by You”; recorded “Remember the question extends Questions before conclusions”; Why connected; Open idea. No edit or duplicate-prevention claim.
5. Coral “Connection not created”: “A connected or supporting thought is unavailable. Choose available thoughts, then review again.” Retain the rationale, with Change thought and Review supporting thoughts. Do not identify which failed or why.
6. Amber “Creation unconfirmed”: readonly submitted details; “It may have completed. Nothing will be sent again automatically.” Copy submitted details and Open idea, without Retry, Check status, success checkmark or a new POST.
